director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch jaise place karenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Theek hai, Riya. Socho ek line ko chaar barabar parts mein baanta; ek part ko number line par kaise dhoondhogi?
Riya, 0 se 1 tak chocolate ko 4 equal pieces karo; har gap 1/4 hai. Do gaps aage wala point ka fraction kya hoga?
Haan Riya, dheere chalte hain. 0 se 1 tak line ko 5 equal gaps mein baanto. Har gap 1/5 hai. Pehla point kaunsa fraction hoga?
Riya, 0 se 1 tak line ke 5 barabar hisse karo. Har hissa 1/5 hai. Pehla nishaan kaunsa fraction hoga?
5 kul hisse hain, par pehla nishaan 1 hissa hai: isliye fraction 1/5. Doosra nishaan kya hoga?
Riya, doosra nishaan 2 gaps aage hai, isliye woh 2/5 hota hai. Agla step dekhna hai?
Riya, kalpana karo: 0 se 1 tak 5 barabar khaane hain; doosra khaana 2/5 hai. Pehla khaana kya hoga?
Haan, Riya. Pehla khaana 1/5 hota hai, kyunki woh 0 se ek gap aage hai. Ab 2/5 wala nishaan batao.
Riya, tumne 7 kaha. Yahan hum fraction ka naam dhoondh rahe hain, isliye 2/5 likhna hoga. 2/5, 1/2 se pehle hai ya baad?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
